body.title: JetBrains status dialog shows completeness
body.summary: RepoStatsDto (DaemonGateway.kt) gains the completeness field (absent decodes as unknown); RepoStatusDialog.kt shows complete/incomplete with the reasons and counts. Anchors: RepoStatsDto in jetbrains-plugin/src/main/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/daemon/DaemonGateway.kt (around :344-357) and the dialog's rendering in actions/RepoStatusDialog.kt (around :99-114). Depends on t12 for the field in repo.stats.
acceptanceChecks: RepoStatsGatewayTest decodes a recorded repo.stats reply with one complete and one incomplete repository, and one without the field
The dialog layout test shows the reasons for the incomplete repository

tests.name: jetbrains-plugin RepoStatsGatewayTest.kt: decode a recorded repo.stats reply (complete, incomplete, no field)
jetbrains-plugin RepoStatusPopupLayoutTest.kt: the dialog shows the reasons
